written.headline: KPMG uses 100+ AI agents in pilot audit of FTSE 250 company
written.summary: KPMG used over 100 AI agents in a pilot program to conduct a parallel audit of a FTSE 250 company. The firm found that the AI asked better questions and dug deeper than human staff, though human intervention was needed.

written.headline: Tencent Q3 profit growth stalls as AI capex surges 5x to ~$12B
written.summary: Tencent reported third-quarter revenue up 8% year-over-year to RMB 207.3 billion (~$31.1B), missing analyst estimates, as operating profit fell 7%. Capital expenditures surged 527% to RMB 81.4 billion (~$12B) due to heavy investments in AI infrastructure and chips.

written.headline: Soket AI raises $4 Mn from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies
written.summary: Soket AI has raised $4 million from Bajaj Finserv's Finserv Intelligence and Pennant Technologies to scale its foundation model research. The funding will support enterprise deployments in sectors including financial services, cybersecurity, defence, and enterprise technology.
